Rapid Rashmi – More Than Just a Voice

Rapid Rashmi is a Kannada channel bringing you Celebrity Interviews, Music Videos, Vlogs on Travel, Life, and everything in between.

Known for her express unpredictability and razor-sharp wit, Rashmi won Bengaluru’s heart for 15 years as one of the most loved voices on 92.7 Big FM.

Today, she continues her journey as a performer and creator — with over 3,500 live shows across the globe and playback singing in movies like Deal Raja (and more yet to release).

Don’t miss Mixed Strings — our very own Kannada unplugged music video series, where two soulful songs merge to create pure magic.
